title: Eliza Bickford AI Chatbot (v14)
description:
Eliza AI Chatbot by Jim and Nate (age 10) Bickford
Below are some example starting with the scenario from the original artificial intelligence paper.

Eliza: Hi, I'm Eliza.  What would you like to talk about?
You: men are all alike.   
Eliza: What resemblance do you see?
You: They're always bugging us about something or other.   
Eliza: What are you thinking of?
You: Well my boyfriend made me come here.   
Eliza: How does everyone else around you feel about that?

You: Tell me about Apollo 17.
Eliza: Apollo 17 was launched on Thursday, December 7, 1972, and flew for 301.9 hours, with crew Cernan, Evans, Schmitt using call sign America.

You: Please give me info on Viking mountain.   
Eliza: In Fortnite season 9, "Viking Mountain" (B6) has 11 chests and is very popular as a landing spot.

You: Is the siegebreaker good  
Eliza: Siegebreakers are legendary Fortnite auto rifles that give 35.7 damage per shot with a max firing rate of 12 and a magazine size of 30.

You: I have anxiety about my friends.   
Eliza: Can you elaborate on that?
You: I have a very acrimonious relationship with Sally.      
Eliza: Is it always of or pertaining to words, arguments, quarrels?
You: The issues are somewhat arbitrary.   
Eliza: In what ways is it random, not based on reason or system?
You: There isn't a single type of issue with her.   
Eliza: How do you feel about that?
You: It bugs me when she is so arrogant.   
Eliza: Do you like it to be haughty, conceited?

You: I'd like to learn more about Redstone.   
Eliza: Minecraft Redstone: An ore which can be extracted and used for circuits, torches, and traps.
instructions: Eliza Bickford is a modern implementation of the original chatbot which uses Natural Language Processing and artificial intelligence to have a conversation with its user.   Similar to the classic Eliza, it acts as a Rogerian therapist but can also answer questions about Minecraft, Fortnite, and human spaceflight by leveraging a database of more than 8000 keywords and associated responses.   It can be easily extended to include knowledge about other topics and more advanced interactions.   To try it out, simply type in responses and it will have a conversation with you.  Click on the info button for details on how it works and instructions on making your own version.   Below are some examples.  More info at: https://sites.google.com/view/eliza-your-own-ai-bot/home
